source.name: OpenStreetMap
source.coverage: Current, incomplete contributed OSM features in the existing 6.6 km square; not historical reconstruction.
source.styling: Only source mapped surfaces and aeroways. Missing aeroway widths and subsequent parking/road paint are illustrative, not surveyed.

infrastructure.name: OpenStreetMap
infrastructure.coverage: Only ways touching the bounded 3.2 km square and their referenced nodes; infrastructure outside this partial coverage is unknown.
infrastructure.styling: Mapped locations, surfaces and paths. Missing widths/heights, wire sag, signal hardware, parking paint, gardens and short inferred house connections are illustrative, not surveyed.
infrastructure.method: OSM API v0.6 map bounding-box fallback
